pages.title: Chug Wagon
pages.text: Race 7: Washington, D.C., 5.9 miles. Password: CAPITAL. A chug is what guitarists call a palm-muted riff, the sound of this song's guitar sample. Skitchin' (EA, 1994), Mega Drive / Genesis. Music by Jeff van Dyck.

pages.title: Toned down
pages.text: In December 1993 the US Senate held hearings on violent video games. EA cut Skitchin's violence several times. Warfield: had it gone through Nintendo, 'I'm pretty sure we wouldn't have passed'.
